displayedInputs.question: Which digits can be the ones digit of an even number?

displayedInputs.question: 1 cubic meter equals 1000 cubic decimeters. How many cubic decimeters are 3 cubic meters? Calculate: \(3\times1000=?\)

Which of the following is the value of \(4\times4\times4\)?

What does the denominator of a fraction represent?

choices.A: The number of equal parts into which the whole is divided
